title: OpenSearch
description: The official OpenSearch Brand Guidelines define the core palette Pacific Blue (#005EB8), Deep Blue Sea (#003B5C), Open Sky (#00A3E0) and Pacific Sky (#B9D9EB), plus the secondary colors Purple Sage (#963CBD), Malibu Sunrise (#F65275), Golden Poppy (#FFB81C), Seafoam Mint (#2CD5C4), Midnight Sky (#002A3A) and San Francisco Fog (#D9E1E2).
